Industrial Revolutionaries is the second volume in William Gurstelle's unique exploration of history's great inventors. Each chapter revisits the life and times of one of the forward-thinking revolutionaries who helped create the world we live in. You will not only learn about their great inventions, you'll also get step-by-step instructions for recreating them yourself. History will come to life as you have never experienced it before when you build it with your own hands. Inside this volume, you will discover: Joseph McKibben and the Air Muscle Squire Whipple and the Iron Bridge Abe Lincoln

Minecraft has sold more than one hundred million copies worldwide (about 25 million of those units for the PC and Mac). According to Mojang, since the beginning of 2016 Minecraft continues to average 53,000 copies sold per day. Microsoft bought Minecraft (and Mojang) in 2014 for $2.5 billion. In 2016, Microsoft released a version of Minecraft specifically for educators called MinecraftEdu that is used by thousands of teachers around the world. Minecraft for Makers explores the intersection of this creative and beloved electronic game with the real world. It gives readers the opportunity to tak

A maker's home is their DIY palace. From simple personalization to tricking out a custom connected home, Make: Volume 59 is all about adding maker flair to your abode. In this issue you'll make a NeoPixel map to track the traffic for your morning commute, build a levitating planter straight from the future, and learn how to automatically water your garden. Plus 13 projects inside, including: Build a DIY thermal imaging camera Prank your friends with a pint-sized, noise-making throwie 3D print an articulated blooming flower night light Learn to code with the BBC micro:bit and Make:Code And more

items.human_name: Make: Tips and Tales from the Workshop
items.description: The hard-earned tips and tricks gained by experience are the hidden currency of makers -- passed along in workshops and makerspaces by example and by retelling -- shared wisdom that will help you work smarter, easier, and more efficiently. Who doesn't remember with gratitude the insider secrets they learned from from a parent, shop teacher, or artisan? The best ones are never forgotten! This benchtop reference collects hundreds of ingenious and indispensable shop tips and pearls of wisdom collected by the editors of Make: and some of the most talented and prolific makers who've contributed to

In just three years, Instructables.com has become one of the hottest destinations for makers and DIY enthusiasts of all stripes. Known as "the world's biggest show & tell," makers from around the globe post how-to articles on a staggering variety of topics -- from collecting rainwater for lawn care to hacking toy robots to extracting squid ink. Now, with more than 10,000 articles, the Instructables staff and editors of MAKE: magazine -- with help from the Instructables community -- have put together a collection of solid, time- and user-tested technology and craft projects from the site. T

Whether you're interested in becoming a handyman or developing artisanal woodworking skills, the place to begin is by learning the fundamentals of using basic workshop tools correctly. The place to find out how is right here. Make: Tools is shop class in a book. Consumer-level 3D printers and CNC machines are opening up new possibilities for makers. But there will always be a need for traditional workshop skills and tools. Charles Platt's Make: Tools applies the same approach to its subject matter as his bestselling Make: Electronics -- in-depth explanations and hands-on projects that graduall

People have been playing music on homemade instruments for thousands of years. But creating new instruments is much more than an art form. When you want to make a note sound higher or lower, you have to change the sound waves coming out of the instrument. That's science! When you explore the way different materials produce different sounds, that's engineering. When you speed up or slow down a song, you're counting beats -- using math. And technology makes electronic instruments and devices to record and play back music possible.

Create a dynamic space for designing and building DIY electronic hardware, programming, and manufacturing projects. With this illustrated guide, you’ll learn the benefits of having a Makerspace—a shared space with a set of shared tools—that attracts fellow makers and gives you more resources to work with. You’ll find clear explanations of the tools, software, materials, and layout you need to get started—everything from basic electronics to rapid prototyping technology and inexpensive 3D printers. A Makerspace is the perfect solution for many makers today. While y

Take leather crafting into the 21st century with this complete guide that marries traditional skills to the latest CNC and 3D printing technologies. Learn how to start making your own leather creations with traditional tools, and then take them to incredible new levels with digital design techniques. Leatherworking is one of humankind's oldest skills and remains a fun and exciting way to make great-looking wearables, accessories, and cosplay items. 3D printers and even hobbyist-class CNC machines have created fantastic new opportunities for new directions in this popular hobby. The book is per

Learn how to use Autodesk Fusion 360 to digitally model your own original projects for a 3D printer or a CNC device. Fusion 360 software lets you design, analyze, and print your ideas. Free to students and small businesses alike, it offers solid, surface, organic, direct, and parametric modeling capabilities. Fusion 360 for Makers is written for beginners to 3D modeling software by an experienced teacher. It will get you up and running quickly with the goal of creating models for 3D printing and CNC fabrication. Inside Fusion 360 for Makers , you'll find: Eight easy-to-understand tutorials tha

The results are in for our 6th annual Desktop Digital Fabrication Shoot Out!  Make: Volume 60 has more than 30 reviews that show off the latest and greatest FDM and resin 3D printers, CNC machines, laser cutters, and vinyl cutters, including new machines from Ultimaker, Prusa, Lulzbot, ShopBot, and Glowforge. Also, learn about our revamped 3D printer scoring system! Get the latest reviews of 3D printers and CNC devices Add graphics to your prints using hydrographic film Why you should buy a laser cutter over a 3D printer How to design dual color models for multi-material prints Laser cut

Makers of the Modern World is the third volume of William Gurstelle's unique, hands-on journey through history. Each chapter examines a remarkable character from the past, one of the people whose insights and inventions helped create our modern world. What sets this series apart from other history books - including other histories of technology - is that each chapter also includes step-by-step instructions for making your own version of the historical invention. History comes to life in a way you have never experienced before when you follow the inventors' steps and recreate the groundbreaking

What is a bicycle? The answer is a little trickier than you might think. More than just a form of transportation, your bike is a framework on which you can explore and display your own inventiveness. With a full history of the bicycle and information about commercial mods such as adding baby seats and fenders--as well as instruction on wheels, tires, and regular maintenance--this book gives you the tools and ideas to hack your ride your own way. You'll not only find out how to strip down your bike so that you can actually put it back together again, but you'll create a complete bike hacker's w

items.human_name: Make: Workshop Mastery with Jimmy DiResta
items.description: Jimmy DiResta has made a name for himself with his inventiveness and workshop skills, creating dozens of projects for YouTube videos and television shows such as Hammered and Against the Grain on the DIY network. In Make: Workshop Mastery With Jimmy DiResta , Jimmy and co-author John Baichtal teach readers essential workshop skills with over a dozen projects that explore everything from mold-making to CNC routing on to metalsmithing.Projects in this book include: Tool-drawer cabinet A chess set One-sheet metal stool A machete Crowbar-hammer mashup An electric guitar with a carved body Your own

items.human_name: Doctor Who: Supremacy of the Cybermen
developers: Cavan Scott, George Mann, Ivan Rodriguez, Walter Geovanni, Nichola Righi
items.description: The Cybermen have already won… YOU WILL BE DELETED! Exiled from Gallifey at the very end of Time, Rassilon, fallen leader of the Time Lords, has been captured by the last of the Cybermen. Now the Cybermen have access to time travel! With it, every defeat is now a victory. All of the Doctors’ lives are in great peril, but will they be able to defeat the odds and champion over a Cyberized universe?! “The perfect way to celebrate the Cybermen’s 50th anniversary!” – Pop Culture Bandit

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Thirteenth Doctor - Time Out of Mind
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: The Doctor celebrates the holidays the only way she can – with mystery, danger and a little help from her friends! Joint the Thirteenth Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz as they find themselves caught in a deadly game of chance! What follows is a magical, memory-altering adventure through space, featuring aliens, elves, toy soldiers, and… could it be… Santa!? “Delightfully quirky and very suspenseful.” – Women Write About Comics

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 3
developers: Al Ewing, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Boo Cook, Warren Pleece, Gary Caldwell, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Eleventh Doctor’s bold new adventures continue, as the Doctor is confronted by his greatest failure, Alice faces her darkest hour, the shapeshifting ARC’s origin is revealed, and chameleonic pop star Jones reaches transcendence! All this, and a Cyber-invasion of ancient Rome… and the final stand against the Talent Scout. “High powered comic book teamwork: near gallery-worthy!” – Warped Factor

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Archives Omnibus Vol.2
developers: Joshua Hale Fialkov, Andy Diggle, Brandon Seifert, Len Wein, Tony Lee, Matthew Dow Smith, Mark Buckingham, Philip Bond, Ilias Kyriazis, Mitch Gerads, Josh Adams, Marc Deering, Horcaio Domingues, Andres Ponce, Ruben Gonzalez	Charlie Kirchoff, Adrian Salmon, Mitch Gerads
items.description: Get whisked aboard the TARDIS with the Eleventh Doctor, Amy and Rory! From Silurian horrors in Casablanca to time-stealing shadows and the space-cruise of a lifetime – there’s no time to rest for the Doctor and his friends.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Archives Omnibus Vol.3
developers: Andy Diggle, Eddie Robson, Tony Lee, Matthew Dow Smith, Paul Cornell, Andy Kuhn, Mike Collins, Horacio Domingues, Ruben Gonzalez, Jimmy Broxton	Charlie Kirchoff, Phil Elliott
items.description: Follow the Eleventh Doctor and his new companion Clara Oswald to the farthest reaches of the galaxy! Woeful white holes cause dimensional instability inside the TARDIS – and a murder mystery in the Wild West sees the Doctor come face to face with an unexpected host of undead murder victims.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eighth Doctor collection
developers: George Mann, Emma Vieceli, Hi Fi
items.description: The Eighth Doctor, as played by Paul McGann, is shocked to find one of his old houses on Earth has been taken over by a young artist, Josie Day – an artist whose paintings are inexplicably coming to life. The search for the shocking truth of Josie’s powers sends the pair on an epic quest through space and time – from a shattering test of faith in a civil war, to a creepy Victorian magic show, a cursed stately home, and a final revelation in the stars! “Hits all the right buttons!” – Fandom Post

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Thirteenth Doctor Volume 3
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Rachael Stott, Enrica Eren Angiolini, Tracy Bailey
items.description: In this swashbuckling instalment, The Doctor and her fam – Ryan, Yaz, and Graham – get caught up in the escapades of infamous rogue Time Lord, the Corsair! Accused of a crime she didn’t commit, The Doctor becomes involved in a daring heist with her old friend in order to retrieve something valuable for the Corsair’s mysterious benefactor. Created for the TV series by renowned author Neil Gaiman, this is the Corsair’s first ever appearance! Includes a special feature on the creations of the Corsair. “Highly recommended… Bold, sassy, intelligent and accessible to new fans. 5 out of 5!” – Geek Sy

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Ninth Doctor Volume 4
developers: Cavan Scott, Adriana Melo, Cris Bolson, Marco Lesko
items.description: Two staggering adventures see the Doctor and his companions facing psyche-shattering conspiracies and ancient secrets! First, the Doctor goes undercover at a prisoner rehabilitation facility held within a collapsing singularity… Meanwhile, Captain Jack has left the TARDIS and when the object of an assassination he was supposedly responsible for turns up alive and well, Jack must delve deep into a past he would rather leave behind! “Nothing short of sensational!” – Snap Pow

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Archives Omnibus Vol.1
developers: Tony Lee, Joshua Hale Fialkov, Matthew Dow Smith, Dan McDaid, Andrew Currie, Richard Piers Rayner, Horacio Domingues, Tim Hamilton, Mark Buckingham, Matthew Dow Smith, Josh Adams, Paul Grist, Blair Shedd, Mitch Gerads, Dan McDaid	Charlie Kirchoff, Phil Elliott, Rachelle Rosenberg, Mitch Gerads, Kyle Latino, Deborah McCumiskey
items.description: From an attack by sentient spam mail to a serial killer stalking the streets of London, from a collision of worlds on a pleasure planet to a swapping of brains in an off-world hospital – the Eleventh Doctor’s travels with Amy and Rory ranged far and wide, as this first omnibus collection reveals.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Year 3 Vol.2
developers: George Mann, James Peaty, I.N.J. Culbard, Ivan Rodriguez, Wellington Diaz, Klebs Junior, Leandro Casco, Triona Farrell, Stefani Renne, Thiago Ribeiro
items.description: The Doctor, Alice, and the Sapling – now growing further into adulthood – take on a new wave of insane adventures! Still missing many of their most treasured memories, the TARDIS team stumble across a Memory Ark, and their reality starts to fray further at the edges… Then, can the Doctor and Alice stop the Sapling from growing into the genocidal creature of destruction it might be doomed to be? “Ood’-les of fun!” – Comicosity

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Year 3 Vol.3
developers: Alex Paknadel, Rob Williams, I.N.J. Culbard, Ivan Rodriguez, JB Bastos, Luiz Campello, Triona Farrell, Thiago Ribeiro, Stafani Rennee
items.description: The Doctor and Alice must finally face up to the Sapling’s true nature… but has their influence managed to calm his destructive instincts? Or will they find themselves at his terrifying mercy? With the Scream hot on their tail, intent on using the Sapling for his own nefarious purposes, the Doctor and Alice must make an impossible choice… Meanwhile, the Doctor has possibly found another Time Lord! “An inspired trip back to early Gallifreyan society!” – Nerdy

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Year 3 Vol.1
developers: Rob Williams, Alex Paknadel, I.N.J. Culbard, Simon Fraser, Leandro Casco, Wellington Diaz, Triona Farrell, Gary Caldwell
items.description: The Eleventh Doctor and Alice are back for the start of a brand-new season! Who – or what – is the Scream? How is the Sapling connected to both the Doctor and Alice? Who else joins the TARDIS? Discover what unforgettable sights – and unfathomable dangers – they’ll experience on this all-new rollercoaster ride of a year! “Plenty of style and fast-paced action!” – Newsarama

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Year 3 Vol.1
developers: George Mann, James Peaty, Mariano Laclaustra, Warren Pleece, Carlos Cabrera, Hernan Cabrera, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Twelfth Doctor grapples with two deadly small towns in this brand-new collection, kicking off Year Three! It’s the return of fan-favorite comics companion, space bassist Hattie, as the Doctor takes her for the best fish and chips in the galaxy. But there’s something ancient and unknowable beneath the waves of the 1970s seaside town where they end up – something weaves itself into Hattie’s dreams and drags itself up onto land in mounds of shambling seaweed! “Continues to impress.” – Kaboooom

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Year 3 Vol.2
developers: Richard Dinnick, Brian Williamson, Pasquale Qualano,	Hi-Fi
items.description: In Bill’s first comic book adventure, the TARDIS crashes into the heart of a Viking camp! But this is no interactive history lesson – a terrifying alien force has taken over the icy kingdom. As the snow melts, the Doctor realizes that he is about to face more than one unwelcome face from the past... and for a different flavor of peril, the Doctor takes Bill and Nardole on a trip to an intergalactic superstore, where they make an unexpected new friend… or is that enemy?! “A seamless narrative.” – Fandom Post

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Year 3 Vol.3
developers: Richard Dinnick, Francesco Manna, Pasquale Qualano, Hi-Fi
items.description: When the Doctor and his companions are drawn to a seemingly empty transport vessel in deep space, they’re pulled into an impossible conflict – between the robotic Heavenly Host… and the Weeping Angels! Featuring the Twelfth Doctor and fan favorite companions Bill, Nardole, and Missy… along with some other familiar faces. “Genuine, humor, mystery, and tension.” – Doctor Who News

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 5
developers: Nick Abadzis, Eleonora Carlini, Elena Casagrande, Iolanda Zanfardino, Arianna Florean, Rod Fernandes, Hi-Fi
items.description: Trapped in the Arena of Fear, and with their memories wiped, the Tenth Doctor and Gabriella Gonzalez, along with their friends Cindy, Cleo, and even Captain Jack Harkness, are forced to battle against one another – to the death! Worse – those who escape the madness risk losing everything they are – at the hands of the Wishing Well Witch! Join the Doctor and for a collection of stunning revelations, wide-screen action, and deeply personal surprises! “A great blend of humor, mystery and horror” – The Geek Girl Project

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 6
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Eleonora Carlini, Arianna Florean
items.description: When Cindy, the Doctor, and Gabby battle an ancient Nocturne in New Orleans at the height of the Jazz Age, Cindy faces a deadly challenge that will leave her forever changed! And before they have a chance to digest the fallout from that encounter, the Tenth Dotor TARDIS team are pulled back to face the wrath of Anubis, who’s becoming more like his father, Sutekh, every day! Join the Doctor, Gabby and Cindy for more adventure in space, time, and even love! “Nick Abadzis and crew have come up with a real corker!” – Fandom Post

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 7
developers: Nick Abadzis, James Peaty, Giorgia Sposito, Warren Pleece, Arianna Florean, Hi-Fi
items.description: The epic conclusion of the Tenth Doctor’s second year of all-new adventures! On the impossible starship Shining Horizon, the ancient entity Sutekh has risen again – and this time, he’s brought some fearsome allies! Will the TARDIS team, along with Dorothy and Anubis, be able to stop them? Join the Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy for more adventures and battles against ancient gods! “An energetic, high-tension ending to an impressive second year.” – Warped Factor

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 1
developers: Nick Abadzis, Elena Casagrande, Arianna Florean
items.description: Two strangers: the Doctor, charming, eccentric Time Lord with a past as dark and heavy as a black hole; Gabriella Gonzalez, waitress and wannabe artist with a future dragging her down like lead chains. Hurled together by a wave of psychic horror haunting New York, they embark on an epic new adventure across time and space. “A perfect debut!” – Project Fandom

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 2
developers: Robbie Morrison, Daniel Indro, Eleonora Carlini, Slamet Mujiono, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Tenth Doctor and his new companion, Gabriella Gonzalez, take a terrifying trip into history, when a left turn in the Time Vortex strands them in the bomb-besieged trenches of World War I! And it’s not just the churning mud or the constant bombardments they have to worry about… the fearsome Weeping Angels are here and feasting on the futures of the soldiers on all sides! “Weeping Angels + Tenth Doctor = Magic. That simple.” – Whatcha Reading

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Ninth Doctor Volume 3
developers: Cavan Scott, Adriano Melo, Cris Bolson, Marco Lesko
items.description: Team TARDIS are in hot pursuit of a monster they accidentally sent back to the 1970s (or is it the 1980s?) – only to find a colossal kaiju tearing up the British channel, and UNIT out of their depth! A face from the Doctor’s past may have all the answers. Next, in search for Jack’s missing memories takes the TARDIS to 17th Century Brazil, and into the grip of slavers both alien and all-too-human! Will Jack find what he seeks – or lose the trust of his friends? “Absolutely spectacular” – Pop Culture Bandit

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 3
developers: Tony Lee, Jonathan L. Davis, Matthew Dow Smith, Al Davison, Blair Shedd, Matthew Dow Smith, Kelly Yates	Lovern Kindzierski, Charlie Kirchoff, Phil Elliott
items.description: When the TARDIS is attacked, the Tenth Doctor is propelled into a desperate race against time to locate the missing console room, before coming face to face with an army of angry trees in Greenwich – and all the while his adversary, the Advocate, is plotting a terrifying terraforming conflict and the ultimate downfall of the Doctor.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Many Lives of Doctor Who
developers: Richard Dinnick, Mariano Laclaustra, Giorgia Sposito, Brian Williamson, Arianna Florean, Claudia Ianniciello, Iolanda Zanfardino, Neil Edwards, Pasquale Qualano, Rachael Stott, Color-ice, Carlos Cabrera, Adele Matera, Dijjo Lima, Enrica Eren Angiolini
items.description: The ultimate celebration of Doctor Who, for fans old and new! As the Doctor regenerates into their Thirteenth incarnation, they flash back across their many lives and many adventures – revealing brand-new stories from every era and face of the Doctor to date. This is the perfect introduction to Doctor Who for new readers, and the ultimate celebration of the series for long-term fans. “Change reminds us why we love an idea, or character as much as we do. Nothing could sum up better than this book why we love Doctor Who so much.” – Nerdly

developers: George Mann, Ivan Rodriguez, Pasquale Qualano, Dennis Calero, Dijjo Lima
items.description: When we last saw Grant, Lucy, and Jennifer in ‘The Return of Doctor Mysterio’, they were settling down together as a family – and Grant’s superhero costume was safely stored away. But that wasn’t the end of the story! Now, the Doctor is swooping back into their lives – because the alien gem that gifted Grant his powers has counterparts all over the universe. It’s up to the Doctor, Grant, Lucy and Jennifer to track them all down – to prevent cosmic disaster! “A fun mash-up of two great genres.” – Capeless Crusaders

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Archives Omnibus Vol.1
developers: Gary Russell, Tony Lee, Nick Roche, Jose Maria Beroy, Stefano Martino, Mirco Pierfederici, Pia Guerra, Kelly Yates, Charlie Kirchoff, Tom Smith, Kris Carter, Liam Shalloo
items.description: Join the Tenth Doctor and Martha as they go in search of the perfect milkshake and instead find themselves manipulated by an intergalactic Pantheon preparing for total war – then land up in a museum dedicated to the Doctor’s nine previous incarnations.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 4
developers: Nick Abadzis, Eleonora Carlini, Elena Casagrande, Leonardo Romero, Arianna Florean, Claudia ‘SG’ Ianniceiello
items.description: The Tenth Doctor and Gabriella Gonzalez set off on a bold new journey! Whether facing an evil corruption of sentient music on a gas giant, journeying back to the dawn of humankind, or battling disc-like gladiatorial captors in a millennia-old free-for-all, there are no limits to the cosmic adventure – or the mortal danger! Strap in as the Doctor tries to untangle himself from an intergalactic conspiracy, bumping into old friends on the way! “Absolute gem.” – Pop Culture Bandit

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Third Doctor collection
items.description: How could you ever win against a deadly hive mind robotic intelligence, capable of creating itself infinite bodies out of thin air? Join forces with the Third Doctor, the infamous U.N.I.T., and a host of staggering guest stars to find out! Twists and turns ensue as the Doctor, the Brigadier, and the Master continue their struggle – and a surprisingly familiar face returns. “A sci-fi James Bond!” – Comics Worth Reading

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Year 3 Vol. 3
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Adele Matera, Arianna Florean
items.description: The Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy are threatened by the most deadly cosmic entity they’ve ever faced – one that could eradicate the Doctor’s very timeline! Year Three of the Tenth Doctor’s comic adventures reaches its game-changing conclusion with devastating consequences for everyone on board the TARDIS! Can they all make it out in one piece? Or will the fate of these beloved companions be changed forever? “Fans will love this immensely!” – Kabooooom

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Year 3 Vol. 2
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Iolanda Zanfardino	, Arianna Florean, Nicola Righi
items.description: The Doctor has abandoned his crew to chase a mysterious message into deep space! As Cindy recovers from the splitting headache she developed on her most recent adventure, Gabby’s mysterious block-transfer butterfly powers evolve even further. But will the team ever be reunited? And what secrets will the Doctor find waiting for him, out in the cosmic dark? The Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy face more challenges than ever before. “Absolutely brilliant – gorgeous illustrations and a knockout story 10/10.” – Blogtor Who

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Year 3 Vol. 1
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Arianna Florean, Hi-Fi
items.description: It’s the start of a brand-new year for the Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy, and things are looking very different for the Tenth Doctor’s TARDIS team! Dangerously different, in fact! Did the Doctor really abandon Gabby and Cindy back to their life on Earth – and why is he wandering homeless, without his TARDIS, on a mystifying alien world? The truth will dazzle, terrify, and entertain you! “A delightfully fun read – highly recommended.” – All Comic

developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: For the first time ever, Titan Comics proudly presents the Daleks! Part of the BBC’s epic multi-platform crossover event, Time Lord Victorious, Eisner-nominated Jody Houser (Supergirl) and fan-favorite artist Roberta Ingranata (Witchblade) send the Tenth Doctor on another spectacular adventure! After awakening from an alternate reality where the Time War never took place, the Tenth Doctor is recruited by his deadly nemesis, the Daleks, to defeat a terror that even they fear. Can the Doctor make peace with his nemesis in order to stop this unknown monster from the Dark Times as it seeks to exti

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 5
developers: Si Spurrier, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Warren Pleece, Leandro Casco, Leonardo Romero, Gary Caldwell, Hi-Fi, Rod Fernandes, Arianna Florean, Nicola Righi
items.description: The companions don’t die. That’s rule #1 for the Eleventh Doctor. But with an immortal temporal bounty-hunter still on his trail and an exponentially growing Malignant entity following in the wake of the TARDIS, how long will he be able to protect them? Will Alice, the Squire, Abslom Daak, or even River Song perish – just as answers seem within their grasp? “A great mix of comedy, action and danger!” – Blogter Who

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Lost Dimension Vol.1
developers: George Mann, Cavan Scott, Nick Abadzis, Rachael Stott, Adriana Melo, Cris Bolson, Mariano Laclaustra, Carlos Cabrera, Leandro Casco, I.N.J. Culbard, Rod Fernandes, Marco Lesko, Dijjo Lima, Hernan Cabrera, IHQ Studios
items.description: When the universe is threatened, when the laws of Time, Space and Reality break down, different incarnations of the Doctor can meet. It should never happen. But this is one of those days! Witness an unprecedented crossover between all thirteen Doctors to date, in an epic struggle for the future of the universe – guest starring Jenny, the Doctor’s daughter! The Doctors must battle an all-consuming white hole – and uncover the deadly secret of the void between universes. “Expansive, charming and gorgeous.” – Newsarama

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Lost Dimension Vol.2
developers: Gordon Rennie, Emma Beeby, George Mann, Cavan Scott, Ivan Rodriguez, Wellington Diaz, Rachael Stott, Mariano Laclaustra	Thiago Ribeiro, Mauricio Wallace, Rod Fernandes, Carlos Cabreras
items.description: The universe is collapsing, swallowed up by the void – and the people of Earth have turned against the Doctor, forcing him to team up with his past and future selves. The unprecedented crossover between all thirteen doctors (to date) continues, as the secret of the void is revealed, the Fourth Doctor and Rivers Song play crucial parts in the survival of all of Time and Space, and the final, spectacular conflict is engaged! “A joy for Doctor Who fans.” – Fortress of Solitude

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 6
developers: Si Spurrier, Rob Williams, I.N.J. Culbard, Simon Fraser, Marcio Menys, Gary Caldwell
items.description: The mindbending truth about the Doctor’s quest to clear his name is finally revealed! Featuring a stunning new adventure in the depths of the Time War, as Alice Obiefune comes face to face with the War Doctor! Plus: the final fates of the Squire, Abslom Daak, and the deadly cult of Exterminhate! It’s an unmissable cosmic adventure, as gods live and die – and time itself is shaken to its core! “A treat both narratively and visually!” – Newsarama

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 1

developers: Cavan Scott, Adriana Melo, Cris Bolson, Matheus Lopes, Marco Lesko

items.description: As the Time War rages, Cardinal Ollistra of Gallifrey seeks to create ever more dangerous weapons to deploy against the enemy. The Doctor finds himself leading a desperate race for survival, in which the shadows may be the least of their worries…
Three brand new adventures featuring Christopher Eccleston as the Ninth Doctor, written by Nicholas Briggs.

Four stories set in the Eleventh Doctor era, narrated by Jacob Dudman: The Calendar Man by AK Benedict, The Top of the Tree by Simon Guerrier, The Light Keepers by Roy Gill and False Coronets by Alice Cavender.

The Doctor, Ace and Benny find themselves caught up in the very real events of Shakespeare's greatest play, and begin to realise that the truth about the planet Menaxus may be far stranger than anyone imagined...

items.human_name: CDNM2.1 Night of the Vashta Nerada
items.description: Funworld was set to be the happiest planet in the galaxy. Except construction was dogged by reports of a predator and then all communication ceased. Now Amanda Steele's crew are being picked off one by one, and something terrifying lurks in the shadows...

Having saved the universe and restored peace at home, the Doctor and Liv go in search of their friend, Helen. Following a trail of breadcrumbs through space and time they discover an unsavoury conspiracy, and an old enemy lurking in the shadows, waiting.

When River Song goes shopping for a whole load of unclaimed loyalty points, she uncovers secrets linked to her tangled past. The Doctor arrives, and the mystery deepens. Madame Kovarian has been busy, and this time she will not accept failure…
Two brand new adventures for the Third Doctor: Prisoners of the Lake by Justin Richards and The Havoc of Empires by Andy Lane.

The Doctor offers Tegan and Nyssa a trip to the paradise world of Florana, but instead the TARDIS takes them to a domed city on a planet scarred by warfare. A world where everyone is young, and fighting for the glory of the Elite...

The Doctor, Steven and Sara arrive on an asteroid and are unwittingly caught in the middle of a battle between the Space Security Service and strange squat aliens in armour. But just who can they really trust in this battle against the Sontarans?

When a distress call rips the TARDIS from the Vortex it arrives in the midst of a conflict between Gallifrey and an ancient foe. The Empire of the Racnoss is at war, and wherever he stands, the Doctor is on the wrong side.

The first time the Doctor met River Song, he saw her die. And now she's asking him on a date. Well, not a date, exactly... More of a mission. With billions of lives hanging in the balance, can the Doctor afford not to do whatever River wants?

When the destruction of an obscene weapon leads to the Time Lord once known as the Doctor uncovering a secret Gallifreyan initiative, he cannot believe what is being considered. Should victory be sought at any cost?

With K9 off in the TARDIS leading the Black Guardian on a wild goose chase, the Doctor and Romana are enjoying life in a London townhouse. As the Doctor dodges deadly butlers, Romana faces a malevolent Aunt and an even deadlier peril - marriage!

On a research station near a black hole, time keeps standing still. With the safety of thousands balancing out the need to flee, the Doctor reluctantly finds himself involved in a race against time. But nothing is ever as simple as it appears...

Katy Bell returns to her Midlands home to find strange goings-on at the buskers fair. A witch trial in the 1980s. A bonfire ready to be lit... There is black magic in the Black Country, and the Doctor has the name of his enemy on the tip of his tongue...

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Vol. 3
items.description: The Doctor and Clara are back for two stunning new trips through the Vortex. On a jaunt back to 1845, the pair discover a horrifying secret hidden in a stately home! Then, the malevolent Hyperions return to scorch the solar system of all life – and the Doctor is pulled into an epic war for the future of all humankind. Writers Robbie Morrison (‘Drowntown’, ‘Judge Dredd’, ‘Nikolai Dante’) and George Mann (‘Newbury & Hobbes’, ‘The Eighth Doctor’) join stunning artists Daniel Indro (‘Sherlock Holmes’), Mariano Laclau

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Vol. 2
items.description: Enter the TARDIS with the Doctor and Clara for two stunning new adventures! First, the pair battle an enemy who can slide between the cracks of the universe and take over unwilling human hosts – the FRACTURES. Then, the pair discovers an alien invasion in 1960s Las Vegas – forcing them to team up with gangsters. Writer Robbie Morrison (‘Drowntown’, ‘Judge Dredd’, ‘Nikolai Dante’) joins astounding artists Brian Williamson (‘Torchwood’, ‘Primeval’) and Mariano Laclaustra (‘Dark Horse Presents’) to blast the Twelf

human_name: Humble Comics Bundle: Doctor Who Megabundle: Explore the Whoniverse
redeem_text: Explore the Whoniverse in comic form. Whovians, this one's for you! The Whoniverse comes alive on the page in this collection of comics, packed with dozens of volumes exploring the Doctor’s adventures and exploits across time and space! See the 8th and 11th Doctors team up to face down the Bad Wolf Empress in Doctor Who: Empire of the Wolf . In Doctor Who: Origins , a mission to hunt down a threat to Gallifrey puts the Doctor in the sites of the secretive Time Lords known as the Division. Get these awesome comics and a great many more, and help support BBC Children in Need with your purchase! Pay $1 or more. Normally, the total cost for the comics in this bundle is as much as $895. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum $1 purchase. Read them anywhere. The comics in this bundle are available in PDF and CBZ formats, so they work on your computer, e-readers, iPads, cell phones, and a wide array of mobile devices! Instructions and a list of recommended reading programs can be found here . Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the publisher and to support BBC Children in Need. If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too! Whovians, this one's for you! Get these awesome comics and a great many more, and help support BBC Children in Need with your purchase!

items.human_name: Doctor Who: Supremacy of the Cybermen
developers: Cavan Scott, George Mann, Ivan Rodriguez, Walter Geovanni, Nichola Righi
items.description: The Cybermen have already won… YOU WILL BE DELETED! Exiled from Gallifey at the very end of Time, Rassilon, fallen leader of the Time Lords, has been captured by the last of the Cybermen. Now the Cybermen have access to time travel! With it, every defeat is now a victory. All of the Doctors’ lives are in great peril, but will they be able to defeat the odds and champion over a Cyberized universe?! “The perfect way to celebrate the Cybermen’s 50th anniversary!” – Pop Culture Bandit

developers: Paul Cornell, Neil Edwards, Ivan Nunes
items.description: The Tenth, Eleventh and Twelfth incarnations of the Doctor come face to face for the first time ever in this stunning Doctor Who comics crossover event. Maneuvered into an impossible meeting, the Doctors and their companions must uncover an immensely powerful foe, fix the time stream, and right an ancient wrong – in the next chapter of their astounding ongoing comics adventures! “You need to be reading Four Doctors now!” – Flickering Myth

developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata , Warnia K. Sahadewa
items.description: The Doctor has had many lives… some it seems she doesn’t even remember. This is the story of one, known as the Fugitive Doctor! Eisner-nominated writer Jody Houser (Supergirl, Stranger Things) and fan-favorite artist Roberta Ingranata (Witchblade) return for another spectacular time-traveling adventure which deepens the lore of the Doctor Who universe. The clandestine Time Lord organization called Division has sent the Doctor to eliminate a threat to Gallifrey. Joined by her new partner, Taslo, they soon discover something is amiss. What secret are the Time Lords hiding? And how much danger do

developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata , Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: Celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Master in this glorious graphic novel from Eisner-nominated writer Jody Houser (Star Wars, Supergirl) and fan-favorite artist Roberta Ingranata (Witchblade, Doctor Who: Thirteenth Doctor). Missy (played by Michelle Gomez) is up to her old tricks, but this time she’s not alone! In a bid to obtain the Key to Time, Missy enlists the help of an unexpected ally – her first incarnation as the Master (played by the infamous Roger Delgado). But why on earth is Missy dressed like… the Doctor? All is not as it seems, and betrayal is everywhere! How will the Doctor s

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 6: The Malignant Truth
developers: Si Spurrier, Rob Williams, I.N.J. Culbard, Simon Fraser, Marcio Menys, Gary Caldwell
items.description: The mindbending truth about the Doctor’s quest to clear his name is finally revealed! Featuring a stunning new adventure in the depths of the Time War, as Alice Obiefune comes face to face with the War Doctor! Plus: the final fates of the Squire, Abslom Daak, and the deadly cult of Exterminhate! It’s an unmissable cosmic adventure, as gods live and die – and time itself is shaken to its core! “A treat both narratively and visually!” – Newsarama

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 7: War of Gods
developers: Nick Abadzis, James Peaty, Giorgia Sposito, Warren Pleece, Arianna Florean, Hi-Fi
items.description: The epic conclusion of the Tenth Doctor’s second year of all-new adventures! On the impossible starship Shining Horizon, the ancient entity Sutekh has risen again – and this time, he’s brought some fearsome allies! Will the TARDIS team, along with Dorothy and Anubis, be able to stop them? Join the Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy for more adventures and battles against ancient gods! “An energetic, high-tension ending to an impressive second year.” – Warped Factor

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Archives Volume 2
developers: Leah Moor, John Reppion, Tony Lee, John Ostrander, Richard Starkings, Rich Johnston, Charlie Kirchoff, Ben Templesmith, Paul Grist, Kelly Yates, Adrian Salmon, Eric J, Tom Mandrake, Al Davison, Matthew Dow Smith, Phil Elliott, Kris Carter, Charlie Kirchoff, Lovern Kindzierski
items.description: Menaced by an emotion-eating empathivore and a malignant macro-virus, pursued by agents of the Victorian Torchwood Institute and a planet’s worth of rampant robots, the Tenth Doctor certainly needs his wits about him in these stories – and that’s before he’s put on trial for time-meddling by the Shadow Proclamation!

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Fouth Doctor: Gaze of the Medusa
developers: Gordon Rennie, Emma Beeby, Brian Williamson, Hi-Fi
items.description: When the Fourth Doctor and Sarah Jane Smith took a trip to London in 1887, they didn't count on being dragged into a petrifying alien conspiracy that stretches all the way back to Ancient Greece! Pursued through the streets by the fearsome Scryclops, and at the mercy of the mysterious Lady Emily Carstairs, the pair must team with Professor Odysseus James and his adventurer daughter, Athena, to avoid a horrifying fate – one already set in stone. "If you're a classic Doctor Who fan, you will love this book. And if you aren't, this book may yet turn you into one. It's that good!" – Kabooooom "It'

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Year 3: Facing Fate Volume 2: Vortex Butterflies
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Iolanda Zanfardino, Arianna Florean, Nicola Righi
items.description: The Doctor has abandoned his crew to chase a mysterious message into deep space! As Cindy recovers from the splitting headache she developed on her most recent adventure, Gabby’s mysterious block-transfer butterfly powers evolve even further. But will the team ever be reunited? And what secrets will the Doctor find waiting for him, out in the cosmic dark? The Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy face more challenges than ever before. “Absolutely brilliant – gorgeous illustrations and a knockout story 10/10.” – Blogtor Who

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Year 3: The Sapling Volume 2: Roots
developers: George Mann, James Peaty, I.N.J. Culbard, Ivan Rodriguez, Wellington Diaz, Klebs Junior, Leandro Casco, Triona Farrell, Stefani Renne, Thiago Ribeiro
items.description: The Doctor, Alice, and the Sapling – now growing further into adulthood – take on a new wave of insane adventures! Still missing many of their most treasured memories, the TARDIS team stumble across a Memory Ark, and their reality starts to fray further at the edges… Then, can the Doctor and Alice stop the Sapling from growing into the genocidal creature of destruction it might be doomed to be? “Ood’-les of fun!” – Comicosity

developers: George Mann, Emma Vieceli, Hi Fi
items.description: The Eighth Doctor, as played by Paul McGann, is shocked to find one of his old houses on Earth has been taken over by a young artist, Josie Day – an artist whose paintings are inexplicably coming to life. The search for the shocking truth of Josie’s powers sends the pair on an epic quest through space and time – from a shattering test of faith in a civil war, to a creepy Victorian magic show, a cursed stately home, and a final revelation in the stars! “Hits all the right buttons!” – Fandom Post

developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: For the first time ever, Titan Comics proudly presents the Daleks! Part of the BBC’s epic multi-platform crossover event, Time Lord Victorious, Eisner-nominated Jody Houser (Supergirl) and fan-favorite artist Roberta Ingranata (Witchblade) send the Tenth Doctor on another spectacular adventure! After awakening from an alternate reality where the Time War never took place, the Tenth Doctor is recruited by his deadly nemesis, the Daleks, to defeat a terror that even they fear. Can the Doctor make peace with his nemesis in order to stop this unknown monster from the Dark Times as it seeks to exti

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 5: Arena of Fear
developers: Nick Abadzis, Eleonora Carlini, Elena Casagrande, Iolanda Zanfardino, Arianna Florean, Rod Fernandes, Hi-Fi
items.description: Trapped in the Arena of Fear, and with their memories wiped, the Tenth Doctor and Gabriella Gonzalez, along with their friends Cindy, Cleo, and even Captain Jack Harkness, are forced to battle against one another – to the death! Worse – those who escape the madness risk losing everything they are – at the hands of the Wishing Well Witch! Join the Doctor and for a collection of stunning revelations, wide-screen action, and deeply personal surprises! “A great blend of humor, mystery and horror” – The Geek Girl Project

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Lost Dimension Volume 2
developers: Gordon Rennie, Emma Beeby, George Mann, Cavan Scott, Ivan Rodriguez, Wellington Diaz, Rachael Stott, Mariano Laclaustra, Thiago Ribeiro, Mauricio Wallace, Rod Fernandes, Carlos Cabreras
items.description: The universe is collapsing, swallowed up by the void – and the people of Earth have turned against the Doctor, forcing him to team up with his past and future selves. The unprecedented crossover between all thirteen doctors (to date) continues, as the secret of the void is revealed, the Fourth Doctor and Rivers Song play crucial parts in the survival of all of Time and Space, and the final, spectacular conflict is engaged! “A joy for Doctor Who fans.” – Fortress of Solitude

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 3: The Fountains of Forever
developers: Nick Abadzis, Elena Casagrande, Eleonora Carlini, Rachael Stott, Leonardo Romero, Arianna Florean, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Tenth Doctor and Gabby Gonzalez are back in New York – but there’s barely time for Gabby to catch up with her best friend Cindy Wu before a cosmic terror causes chaos across the city! When an aging Hollywood star is empowered by an extraterrestrial artefact, the Doctor, Gabby and Cindy are swept up in their biggest adventure yet! “Fun, exciting and inviting to fans both old and new!” – Snap Pow

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 2: Serve You
developers: Al Ewing, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Boo Cook, Warren Pleece, Gary Caldwell, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Eleventh Doctor has an all-new TARDIS crew: whip-smart Alice Obiefune, mercurial Jones and the shapeshifting ARC! But whether battling time in the TARDIS running backwards, alien air war in the Earthly skies, or the deadly machinations of SERVEYOUinc… terror, awe, and danger are never far away! “An excellent story!” – Nerdspan

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Ninth Doctor Volume 3: Official Secrets
developers: Cavan Scott, Adriano Melo, Cris Bolson, Marco Lesko
items.description: Team TARDIS are in hot pursuit of a monster they accidentally sent back to the 1970s (or is it the 1980s?) – only to find a colossal kaiju tearing up the British channel, and UNIT out of their depth! A face from the Doctor’s past may have all the answers. Next, in search for Jack’s missing memories takes the TARDIS to 17th Century Brazil, and into the grip of slavers both alien and all-too-human! Will Jack find what he seeks – or lose the trust of his friends? “Absolutely spectacular” – Pop Culture Bandit

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Year 3: The Sapling Volume 1: Growth
developers: Rob Williams, Alex Paknadel, I.N.J. Culbard, Simon Fraser, Leandro Casco, Wellington Diaz, Triona Farrell, Gary Caldwell
items.description: The Eleventh Doctor and Alice are back for the start of a brand-new season! Who – or what – is the Scream? How is the Sapling connected to both the Doctor and Alice? Who else joins the TARDIS? Discover what unforgettable sights – and unfathomable dangers – they’ll experience on this all-new rollercoaster ride of a year! “Plenty of style and fast-paced action!” – Newsarama

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Ninth Doctor Volume 2: Doctormania
developers: Cavan Scott, Adriana Melo, Cris Bolson, Matheus Lopes, Marco Lesko
items.description: The Ninth Doctor, Rose, and Captain Jack continue their trip through the Universe! Someone is impersonating the Doctor – and has made him into a galactic celebrity! But something far more sinister is going on, as the trio are plunged into yet another shapeshifting civil war… The Slitheen are back! And just as they think their trip can’t get any worse, living gargoyles invade San Francisco and residents begin to fly… “Fast-paced and adrenaline-fueled!” – Comic Book Resources

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Ninth Doctor Volume 4: Sin Eaters
developers: Cavan Scott, Adriana Melo, Cris Bolson, Marco Lesko
items.description: Two staggering adventures see the Doctor and his companions facing psyche-shattering conspiracies and ancient secrets! First, the Doctor goes undercover at a prisoner rehabilitation facility held within a collapsing singularity… Meanwhile, Captain Jack has left the TARDIS and when the object of an assassination he was supposedly responsible for turns up alive and well, Jack must delve deep into a past he would rather leave behind! “Nothing short of sensational!” – Snap Pow

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Year 3: The Sapling Volume 3: Branches
developers: Alex Paknadel, Rob Williams, I.N.J. Culbard, Ivan Rodriguez, JB Bastos, Luiz Campello, Triona Farrell, Thiago Ribeiro, Stafani Rennee
items.description: The Doctor and Alice must finally face up to the Sapling’s true nature… but has their influence managed to calm his destructive instincts? Or will they find themselves at his terrifying mercy? With the Scream hot on their tail, intent on using the Sapling for his own nefarious purposes, the Doctor and Alice must make an impossible choice… Meanwhile, the Doctor has possibly found another Time Lord! “An inspired trip back to early Gallifreyan society!” – Nerdy

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 2: The Weeping Angels of Mons
developers: Robbie Morrison, Daniel Indro, Eleonora Carlini, Slamet Mujiono, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Tenth Doctor and his new companion, Gabriella Gonzalez, take a terrifying trip into history, when a left turn in the Time Vortex strands them in the bomb-besieged trenches of World War I! And it’s not just the churning mud or the constant bombardments they have to worry about… the fearsome Weeping Angels are here and feasting on the futures of the soldiers on all sides! “Weeping Angels + Tenth Doctor = Magic. That simple.” – Whatcha Reading

items.human_name: Doctor Who: Time Out Of Mind
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: The Doctor celebrates the holidays the only way she can – with mystery, danger and a little help from her friends! Join the Thirteenth Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz as they find themselves caught in a deadly game of chance! What follows is a magical, memory-altering adventure through space, featuring aliens, elves, toy soldiers, and… could it be… Santa!? “Delightfully quirky and very suspenseful.” – Women Write About Comics

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Volume 5: The Twist
developers: George Mann, Mariano Laclaustra, Rachael Stott, Carlos Cabrera, Alexandre Siquiera, Rodrigo Fernandes
items.description: In the wake of Clara’s exit, the Doctor is flying solo – and finding just as much trouble, danger, and cosmic wonder as ever before! His latest destinations: a space station with a distressing secret and a murder mystery, and a haunted house that’s primed to explode! “The Doctor is back and better than ever!” – Kabooooom

developers: Scott Tipton, David Tipton, Simon Fraser, Lee Sullivan, Mike Collins, Gary Erskine, Philip Bond, John Ridgeway, Kev Hopgood, Roger Langridge, David Messina, Giorgia Sposito, Elena Casagrande, Silvia Califano, Matthew Dow Smith, Kelly Yates, Gary Caldwell, Phil Elliott, Charlie Kirchoff, Scarlet Gothica, Arianna Florean, Azzurra M. Florean
items.description: Don’t miss this astounding journey, featuring the First through Eleventh Doctors in a universe – and history – spanning battle against an unseen (and unimaginable) enemy! When a mysterious figure from the Doctor’s past abducts his companion and freezes them outside of time, only a combination of ALL of the Doctor’s past incarnations will be able to rescue them and safeguard the future.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Many Lives of Doctor Who
developers: Richard Dinnick, Mariano Laclaustra, Giorgia Sposito, Brian Williamson, Arianna Florean, Claudia Ianniciello, Iolanda Zanfardino, Neil Edwards, Pasquale Qualano, Rachael Stott., Color-ice, Carlos Cabrera, Adele Matera, Dijjo Lima, Enrica Eren Angiolini
items.description: The ultimate celebration of Doctor Who, for fans old and new! As the Doctor regenerates into their Thirteenth incarnation, they flash back across their many lives and many adventures – revealing brand-new stories from every era and face of the Doctor to date. This is the perfect introduction to Doctor Who for new readers, and the ultimate celebration of the series for long-term fans. “Change reminds us why we love an idea, or character as much as we do. Nothing could sum up better than this book why we love Doctor Who so much.” – Nerdly

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Volume 1: Terrorformer
developers: Robbie Morrison, Dave Taylor, Hi-Fi, Luis Guerrero
items.description: The Twelfth Doctor has just regenerated – but the universe won’t give him a minute’s rest! Not when there’s a violent, sentient star on the warpath on an terraformed ice planet – or an ancient celestial murdering her way towards resurrection in India in the year 2314! “Exciting and engaging!” – Nerds Unchained

developers: George Mann, Ivan Rodriguez, Pasquale Qualano, Dennis Calero, Dijjo Lima
items.description: When we last saw Grant, Lucy, and Jennifer in ‘The Return of Doctor Mysterio’, they were settling down together as a family – and Grant’s superhero costume was safely stored away. But that wasn’t the end of the story! Now, the Doctor is swooping back into their lives – because the alien gem that gifted Grant his powers has counterparts all over the universe. It’s up to the Doctor, Grant, Lucy and Jennifer to track them all down – to prevent cosmic disaster! “A fun mash-up of two great genres.” – Capeless Crusaders

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 5: The One
developers: Si Spurrier, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Warren Pleece, Leandro Casco, Leonardo Romero, Gary Caldwell, Hi-Fi, Rod Fernandes, Arianna Florean, Nicola Righi
items.description: The companions don’t die. That’s rule #1 for the Eleventh Doctor. But with an immortal temporal bounty-hunter still on his trail and an exponentially growing Malignant entity following in the wake of the TARDIS, how long will he be able to protect them? Will Alice, the Squire, Abslom Daak, or even River Song perish – just as answers seem within their grasp? “A great mix of comedy, action and danger!” – Blogter Who

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Archvies Volume 3
developers: Tony Lee, Jonathan L. Davis, Matthew Dow Smith, Al Davison, Blair Shedd, Matthew Dow Smith, Kelly Yates, Lovern Kindzierski, Charlie Kirchoff, Phil Elliott
items.description: When the TARDIS is attacked, the Tenth Doctor is propelled into a desperate race against time to locate the missing console room, before coming face to face with an army of angry trees in Greenwich – and all the while his adversary, the Advocate, is plotting a terrifying terraforming conflict and the ultimate downfall of the Doctor.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 1: After Life
developers: Al Ewing, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Boo Cook, Gary Caldwell, Hi Fi
items.description: With a force of personality capable of bending time itself and all the energy of a star’s exploding heart, the Doctor blasts into the hollow, tragic life of a woman with so much to offer – and gives her the chance to scream “Geronimo!” at the thrills, colors, and terrors of an infinite universe! “Flawless! 10 out of 10!” – Pop Culture Bandit

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 4: The Then And The Now
developers: Si Spurrier, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Warren Pleece, Gary Caldwell, Hi Fi
items.description: The Eleventh Doctor is accused of terrible war crimes – crimes that he can’t remember committing! Tracked by temporal bounty hunters, both chainsword-wielding and monstrous, the Doctor goes on the run with his companion Alice Obiefune. Only digging deep into the history of the Time War – and the past of the War Doctor – can they hope to clear the Doctor’s name! “A treat for fans” – Clandestine Comics

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Volume 3: Conversion
developers: Al Ewing, Rob Williams, Simon Fraser, Boo Cook, Warren Pleece, Gary Caldwell, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Eleventh Doctor’s bold new adventures continue, as the Doctor is confronted by his greatest failure, Alice faces her darkest hour, the shapeshifting ARC’s origin is revealed, and chameleonic pop star Jones reaches transcendence! All this, and a Cyber-invasion of ancient Rome… and the final stand against the Talent Scout. “High powered comic book teamwork: near gallery-worthy!” – Warped Factor

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 4: The Endless Song
developers: Nick Abadzis, Eleonora Carlini, Elena Casagrande, Leonardo Romero, Arianna Florean, Claudia ‘SG’ Ianniceiello
items.description: The Tenth Doctor and Gabriella Gonzalez set off on a bold new journey! Whether facing an evil corruption of sentient music on a gas giant, journeying back to the dawn of humankind, or battling disc-like gladiatorial captors in a millennia-old free-for-all, there are no limits to the cosmic adventure – or the mortal danger! Strap in as the Doctor tries to untangle himself from an intergalactic conspiracy, bumping into old friends on the way! “Absolute gem.” – Pop Culture Bandit

items.human_name: Doctor Who Free Comic Book Day 2024
developers: Dan Watters, Kelsey Ramsay, Valentina Bianconi
items.description: The Doctor is a Time Lord, traversing through time and space in his trusty TARDIS. He helps those in need wherever, and whenever, he can. Able to regenerate when close to death, the Doctor has lived many lives, been on countless adventures, and known many losses. After his Fourteenth incarnation went through the unique experience of bi-generation, the Fifteenth Doctor appeared by his side. Now, he is exploring the universe with his new best friend, Ruby Sunday.

developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata , Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: Acclaimed writer Jody Houser (Stranger Things, Supergirl) and fan-favorite artist Roberta Ingranata (Witchblade) return to deliver a spectacular time-travelling adventure with the Thirteenth (played by Jodie Whittaker) and Tenth (played by David Tennant) Doctors! After the Tenth and Thirteenth Doctors’ first adventure together, a paradox of their meeting has caused a radical rewrite of history… Sea Devils have taken over the Earth! Rose Tyler leads the human resistance, but there’s more going on that first meets the eye. Can the Doctors reunite, defeat their enemies, and bring reality back to

items.human_name: Doctor Who: Empire of the Wolf
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata , Warnia K. Sahadewa
items.description: From acclaimed writer Jodie Houser (Stranger Things, Supergirl) and fan-favorite artist Roberta Ingranata (Witchblade) comes an all new interstellar adventure featuring the Eleventh (Matt Smith) and Eighth (Paul McGann) Doctors, appearing together in comic form for the first time! Two Doctors. Two Rose Tylers. One imminent reality-shattering paradox. Can the Eighth and Eleventh Doctors work together to stop the Bad Wolf Empress’s diabolical machinations, and get Rose Tyler back to her own universe, before disaster strikes? Collects Doctor Who: Empire of the Wolf #1-4.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Year 3: The Time Trials Volume 2: The Wolves of Winter
developers: Richard Dinnick, Brian Williamson, Pasquale Qualano, Hi-Fi
items.description: In Bill’s first comic book adventure, the TARDIS crashes into the heart of a Viking camp! But this is no interactive history lesson – a terrifying alien force has taken over the icy kingdom. As the snow melts, the Doctor realizes that he is about to face more than one unwelcome face from the past... and for a different flavor of peril, the Doctor takes Bill and Nardole on a trip to an intergalactic superstore, where they make an unexpected new friend… or is that enemy?! “A seamless narrative.” – Fandom Post

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Seventh Doctor: Operation Volcano
developers: Andrew Cartmel, Ben Aaronovitch, Richard Dinnick, Christopher Jones, Jessica Martin, Marco Lesko, Charlie Kirchoff
items.description: Celebrate all-new Seventh Doctor action with his TV showrunner! An unknown intelligence in orbit. A terrifying vessel in the Australian outback. The future of the world at stake. The Intrusion Countermeasures Group activated. And the Doctor and Ace slap bang in the middle of it all. This is OPERATION VOLCANO. Ben Aaronovitch (‘Rivers of London') and his characters from ‘Remembrance of the Daleks' join Andrew Cartmel, and artist Christopher Jones to craft an explosively-propulsive espionage thriller for the ages! Plus, a bonus ‘Mags the Werewolf' adventure by Richard Dinnick, Jessica Martin and

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Year 3: Time Trials Volume 3: A confusion of Angels
developers: Richard Dinnick, Francesco Manna, Pasquale Qualano, Hi-Fi
items.description: When the Doctor and his companions are drawn to a seemingly empty transport vessel in deep space, they’re pulled into an impossible conflict – between the robotic Heavenly Host… and the Weeping Angels! Featuring the Twelfth Doctor and fan favorite companions Bill, Nardole, and Missy… along with some other familiar faces. “Genuine, humor, mystery, and tension.” – Doctor Who News

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Volume 4: The School of Death
developers: Robbie Morrison, Rachael Stott, Simon Fraser, Ivan Nunes, Marcio Menys
items.description: A new year of epic stories begins for the Twelfth Doctor and Clara! While the Doctor makes ‘friends’ on an orbital space station, Clara discovers a deadly, millennia-old conspiracy when one of her teacher friends goes missing at a prestigious Scottish school – and unravelling it could spell her doom! “This comic is perfect!” – My Geeky, Geeky Ways

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Thirteenth Doctor Year 2 Volume 1: A Tale of Two Time Lords
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: Brought together by fate (and a slightly paradox-sick TARDIS), the Thirteenth Doctor and the Tenth Doctor must work together to stop two deadly forces from taking over the Earth – all without causing time itself to implode! Featuring Ryan, Yaz, Graham, the return of Martha Jones, Weeping Angels, Autons, and so much more… This is an adventure you don’t want to miss! “Another Doctor Who story that could be on the screen!” – Geeks Worldwide Review

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Lost Dimension Volume 1
developers: George Mann, Cavan Scott, Nick Abadzis, Rachael Stott, Adriana Melo, Cris Bolson, Mariano Laclaustra, Carlos Cabrera, Leandro Casco, I.N.J. Culbard, Rod Fernandes, Marco Lesko, Dijjo Lima, Hernan Cabrera, IHQ Studios
items.description: When the universe is threatened, when the laws of Time, Space and Reality break down, different incarnations of the Doctor can meet. It should never happen. But this is one of those days! Witness an unprecedented crossover between all thirteen Doctors to date, in an epic struggle for the future of the universe – guest starring Jenny, the Doctor’s daughter! The Doctors must battle an all-consuming white hole – and uncover the deadly secret of the void between universes. “Expansive, charming and gorgeous.” – Newsarama

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Third Doctor: Heralds of Destruction
items.description: How could you ever win against a deadly hive mind robotic intelligence, capable of creating itself infinite bodies out of thin air? Join forces with the Third Doctor, the infamous U.N.I.T., and a host of staggering guest stars to find out! Twists and turns ensue as the Doctor, the Brigadier, and the Master continue their struggle – and a surprisingly familiar face returns. “A sci-fi James Bond!” – Comics Worth Reading

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Ninth Doctor Volume 1: Weapons of Past Destruction
developers: Cavan Scott, Blair Shedd, Rachael Stott, Blair Shedd, Anang Setyawan
items.description: The beloved Ninth Doctor, Rose and Captain Jack return in a thrilling new tale! Time Lord weaponry is being sold on the intergalactic black market, and only the Doctor and his companions stand a chance of stopping a new Time War! While on the hunt, the Doctor is quickly drawn into an interstellar civil war between the cosmically-empowered Unon and the armored Lect. “Highly entertaining character interactions, thought-provoking ideas, and gorgeous art.” – Geeked Out Nation

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Volume 3: Hyperion
developers: Robbie Morrison, George Mann, Daniel Indro, Mariano Laclaustra, Ronilson Freire, Slamet Mujiono, Luis Guerrero
items.description: The Doctor and Clara are back for two stunning new trips through the Vortex! On a jaunt back to 1845, the pair discover a horrifying secret hidden in a stately home! Then, the malevolent Hyperions return to scorch the solar system of all life – and the Doctor is pulled into an epic war for the future of humankind! “Absolutely astounding: pitch-perfect Doctor Who!” – Whatcha Reading

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Archives Volume 1
developers: Tony Lee, Joshua Hale Fialkov, Matthew Dow Smith, Dan McDaid, Andrew Currie, Richard Piers Rayner, Horacio Domingues, Tim Hamilton, Mark Buckingham, Matthew Dow Smith, Josh Adams, Paul Grist, Blair Shedd, Mitch Gerads, Dan McDaid, Charlie Kirchoff, Phil Elliott, Rachelle Rosenberg, Mitch Gerads, Kyle Latino, Deborah McCumiskey
items.description: From an attack by sentient spam mail to a serial killer stalking the streets of London, from a collision of worlds on a pleasure planet to a swapping of brains in an off-world hospital – the Eleventh Doctor’s travels with Amy and Rory ranged far and wide, as this first omnibus collection reveals.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Archives Volume 2
developers: Joshua Hale Fialkov, Andy Diggle, Brandon Seifert, Len Wein, Tony Lee, Matthew Dow Smith, Mark Buckingham, Philip Bond, Ilias Kyriazis, Mitch Gerads, Josh Adams, Marc Deering, Horcaio Domingues, Andres Ponce, Ruben Gonzalez, Charlie Kirchoff, Adrian Salmon, Mitch Gerads
items.description: Get whisked aboard the TARDIS with the Eleventh Doctor, Amy and Rory! From Silurian horrors in Casablanca to time-stealing shadows and the space-cruise of a lifetime – there’s no time to rest for the Doctor and his friends.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Eleventh Doctor Archives Volume 3
developers: Andy Diggle, Eddie Robson, Tony Lee, Matthew Dow Smith, Paul Cornell, Andy Kuhn, Mike Collins, Horacio Domingues, Ruben Gonzalez, Jimmy Broxton, Charlie Kirchoff, Phil Elliott
items.description: Follow the Eleventh Doctor and his new companion Clara Oswald to the farthest reaches of the galaxy! Woeful white holes cause dimensional instability inside the TARDIS – and a murder mystery in the Wild West sees the Doctor come face to face with an unexpected host of undead murder victims.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Thirteenth Doctor Volume 3: Old Friends
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Rachael Stott, Enrica Eren Angiolini, Tracy Bailey
items.description: In this swashbuckling instalment, The Doctor and her fam – Ryan, Yaz, and Graham – get caught up in the escapades of infamous rogue Time Lord, the Corsair! Accused of a crime she didn’t commit, The Doctor becomes involved in a daring heist with her old friend in order to retrieve something valuable for the Corsair’s mysterious benefactor. Created for the TV series by renowned author Neil Gaiman, this is the Corsair’s first ever appearance! Includes a special feature on the creations of the Corsair. “Highly recommended… Bold, sassy, intelligent and accessible to new fans. 5 out of 5!” – Geek Sy

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Year 3: Facing Fate Volume 3: The Good Companion
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Adele Matera, Arianna Florean
items.description: The Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy are threatened by the most deadly cosmic entity they’ve ever faced – one that could eradicate the Doctor’s very timeline! Year Three of the Tenth Doctor’s comic adventures reaches its game-changing conclusion with devastating consequences for everyone on board the TARDIS! Can they all make it out in one piece? Or will the fate of these beloved companions be changed forever? “Fans will love this immensely!” – Kabooooom

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Volume 2: Fractures
developers: Robbie Morrison, George Mann, Brian Williamson, Mariano Laclaustra, Hi-Fi
items.description: Enter the TARDIS with the Doctor and Clara for two stunning new adventures! First, the pair battle an enemy who can slide between the cracks of the universe and take over unwilling human hosts – the FRACTURES! Then, the pair discovers an alien invasion in 1960s Las Vegas – forcing them to team up with gangsters! “Morrison channels the Twelfth Doctor’s voice like no one else!” – Whatcha Reading

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Year 3: Time Trials Volume 1: The Terror Beneath
developers: George Mann, James Peaty, Mariano Laclaustra, Warren Pleece, Carlos Cabrera, Hernan Cabrera, Hi-Fi
items.description: The Twelfth Doctor grapples with two deadly small towns in this brand-new collection, kicking off Year Three! It’s the return of fan-favorite comics companion, space bassist Hattie, as the Doctor takes her for the best fish and chips in the galaxy. But there’s something ancient and unknowable beneath the waves of the 1970s seaside town where they end up – something weaves itself into Hattie’s dreams and drags itself up onto land in mounds of shambling seaweed! “Continues to impress.” – Kaboooom

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Thirteenth Doctor Volume 1: A New Beginning
developers: Jody Houser, Rachael Stott, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: This first collection of the Thirteenth Doctor’s comic book series sees the newest incarnation of the Doctor, along with her new companions – Graham, Yaz and Ryan – trail-blazing through time tackling vile villains, avoiding an intergalactic alien civil war, uncovering the truth behind a secret human time travel experiment, and doing battle with an alien hoarder obsessed with amassing the greatest treasure in the history of the universe! “Every panel is breathtaking!” – Blogtor Who

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Archives Volume 1
developers: Gary Russell, Tony Lee, Nick Roche, Jose Maria Beroy, Stefano Martino, Mirco Pierfederici, Pia Guerra, Kelly Yates, Charlie Kirchoff, Tom Smith, Kris Carter, Liam Shalloo
items.description: Join the Tenth Doctor and Martha as they go in search of the perfect milkshake and instead find themselves manipulated by an intergalactic Pantheon preparing for total war – then land up in a museum dedicated to the Doctor’s nine previous incarnations.

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 6: Sins of the Father
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Eleonora Carlini, Arianna Florean
items.description: When Cindy, the Doctor, and Gabby battle an ancient Nocturne in New Orleans at the height of the Jazz Age, Cindy faces a deadly challenge that will leave her forever changed! And before they have a chance to digest the fallout from that encounter, the Tenth Dotor TARDIS team are pulled back to face the wrath of Anubis, who’s becoming more like his father, Sutekh, every day! Join the Doctor, Gabby and Cindy for more adventure in space, time, and even love! “Nick Abadzis and crew have come up with a real corker!” – Fandom Post

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Road To The Thirteenth Doctor
developers: James Peaty, Jody Houser, Iolanda Zanfardino, Pasquale Qualano, Brian Williamson, Rachael Stott, Dijjo Lima, Enrica Eren Angiolini
items.description: The Doctor takes the road less travelled… where danger and death lie in wait! The Tenth Doctor battles a horrific corporate weapon on a spaceship full of ghosts! The Eleventh Doctor uncovers a steam-powered robot conspiracy in Victorian-era San Francisco! And the Twelfth Doctor and Bill face chaos on the streets of London, as a creative power runs amok! And the road leads directly into the Thirteenth Doctor series, as the Thirteenth Doctor creative team deliver a series of short stories that introduce an all-new friend… or foe! Who is trying to reach the Doctor – and how can they be saved?! “L

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Thirteenth Doctor Volume 2: Hidden Human History
developers: Jody Houser, Roberta Ingranata, Rachael Stott, Erica Eren Angiolini
items.description: This critically acclaimed new story sees the Thirteenth Doctor, Ryan, Yaz and Graham stumble upon a sinister alien race with a thirst for human blood! Their second comic book adventure sees the gang track the Stilean Flesh Eaters throughout history, encountering friends, old and new, along the way. For once, the humans seem to know more about what’s going on than the Doctor, thanks to a podcast (Hidden Human History) that everyone is listening to – everyone except the Doctor, that is… “A radical romp through time and space!” – Nerdist

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Volume 1: Revolutions of Terror
developers: Nick Abadzis, Elena Casagrande, Arianna Florean
items.description: Two strangers: the Doctor, charming, eccentric Time Lord with a past as dark and heavy as a black hole; Gabriella Gonzalez, waitress and wannabe artist with a future dragging her down like lead chains. Hurled together by a wave of psychic horror haunting New York, they embark on an epic new adventure across time and space. “A perfect debut!” – Project Fandom

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Tenth Doctor Year 3: Facing Fate Volume 1: Breakfast at Tyrannies
developers: Nick Abadzis, Giorgia Sposito, Valeria Favoccia, Arianna Florean, Hi-Fi
items.description: It’s the start of a brand-new year for the Doctor, Gabby, and Cindy, and things are looking very different for the Tenth Doctor’s TARDIS team! Dangerously different, in fact! Did the Doctor really abandon Gabby and Cindy back to their life on Earth – and why is he wandering homeless, without his TARDIS, on a mystifying alien world? The truth will dazzle, terrify, and entertain you! “A delightfully fun read – highly recommended.” – All Comic

items.human_name: Doctor Who: The Twelfth Doctor Volume 6: Sonic Boom
developers: Robbie Morrison, Mariano Laclaustra, Rachael Stott, Carlos Cabrera, Hernan Cabrera, Rodrigo Fernandes
items.description: In the reign of King Louis XIV, the Doctor dives into terror in the heart of France when he discovers an ancient, near-immortal entity wearing the undead Cardinal Richelieu like a suit! With the help of sword-slinging opera star Julie D’Aubigny, can the Doctor defeat the dark tendrils of the Cabinet Noir? If so, he has some lessons for the creators who made a comic book based on his life! “Scary and exciting – an all-around excellent story put together by a top-notch creative team!” – The Fandom Post

human_name: Humble Comics Bundle: Doctor Who Megabundle: Explore the Whoniverse ENCORE
redeem_text: Explore the Whoniverse in comic form. Whovians, this one's for you! The Whoniverse comes alive on the page in this collection of comics, packed with dozens of volumes exploring the Doctor’s adventures and exploits across time and space!
